name: ChecklistTasksAdded
description: Describes a service message about tasks added to a checklist.

fields.name: checklist_message
fields.description: Message containing the checklist to which the tasks were added. Note that the [Message](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#message) object in this field will not contain the _reply\_to\_message_ field even if it itself is a reply.

fields.name: tasks
fields.description: List of tasks added to the checklist
